label: Supplied sample cancellation policy (DISP-002)

clauses.title: Free wait time
clauses.text: The supplied sample states a 5 minute free wait period for the trip.

clauses.title: Cancellation fee after wait
clauses.text: The supplied sample states a cancellation fee of 5.00 SGD becomes applicable after the free wait period, paid as driver compensation.

clauses.title: No-show threshold
clauses.text: The supplied sample states a 8 minute no-show threshold for the trip.

unresolved: The sample does not define whether early arrival, scheduled pickup or actual timer start controls the waiting clock.
The sample does not define how the 5 minute free wait and the 8 minute no-show threshold interact for cancellation liability.
The sample reports a GPS-derived 'within 10m' assertion but no accuracy radius measurement.
